information.local: Fixed reference from own/one-hop boundary returns, bootstrapped at CONTACT_READY from the existing displacement estimate. Metric SE(2) readout thereafter; no physical pose/contact truth.
information.shared: Existing all-team vector median drives the existing common phase supervisor; not fully decentralized.
information.safety: Original map, object velocity, QP, contact physics, thresholds and independent stopping/completion unchanged.
information.abstention: Initialization has no measured velocity vote; failed/missing reference matches do not send a fresh navigation vote.
information.limitations: Persistent observed centroid is not known center of mass; bootstrap bias remains; no absolute-error certificate.

evaluation.completion: Original HOLD + physical speed<=.005 for40frames and endpoint error<=.12m
evaluation.safety: Original separation/penetration/solver checks, G500 and scaling separately retained
evaluation.censoring: 600s unfinished is observation cutoff, never successful completion time
evaluation.gate: At least one failure rescued, net completion count increase and zero candidate hard safety failures. Report all lost successes and all G500 changes. No automatic default promotion.
evaluation.statistics: Paired condition differences on one reused development seed; no general probability estimate
evaluation.error_policy: Every planned/started task remains in denominator; no retuning or added cases

comparison_scope: Both arms use common geometry readouts; legacy arm is not original scalar CVT or spacing
preserved: No truth inputs, new sensing, attachment, force/stop changes, safety threshold changes, physics/evaluator changes, manuscript changes, push or tag changes
